questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bikes are cars.

Some cars are trucks.

All trucks are cycles.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cars are cycles.

II. Some cycles are trucks.

III. Some bikes are trucks.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
__Statements__:

All bikes are cars.

Some cars are trucks.

All trucks are cycles

__**Venn Diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f8907d6c4f1da57d4455c9d06ce673b9a03183351f6f318c161d624222d5331.png] 

__Conclusions__:

I. Some cars are cycles → Follow → Because, 'some cars are trucks' and 'all trucks are cycles' which means there are some cars that are cycles.

II. Some cycles are trucks → Follow → Because, 'all trucks are cycles' which means some cycles are definitely trucks.

III. Some bikes are trucks → Does not follow → There is no definite relation given between bikes and trucks so, it can be possible only.

So, only conclusions I and II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some table are chair.

II. No chair is stool.

**Conclusions:**

I. All chair are table.

II. Some chair are stool.

III. All table are stool.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

I. Some table are chair.

II. No chair is stool.

**Venn Diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0050b8212bb2d15aa707c8f27ba087b0405a7f97538be37526206cb3ee68ae2e.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I: All chair are table → Does not follow → Since 'some table are chair', so all chair are table can be possible not definite.

II: Some chair are stool → Does not follow → 'No chair is stool'.

III: All table are stool → Does not follow → 'No chair is stool'.

So, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

For, (27, 8, 76)

⇒ 19 × 4 = 76.

Similarly, for **(56, 48, 32) **

**⇒ 8 × 4 = 32**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

+ and -, 6 and 9

I. 6 - 5 × 9 + 8 ÷ 2

II. 6 - 4 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3
questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f22f57d0cf5c493280a0ab6b7dbaea9e3fc5b035c6d410d59c2f476043bd03a8.png] 

Given Equations :

__
 
• 6 - 5 × 9 + 8 ÷ 2
 
• 6 - 4 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3

​Now,

I. 6 - 5 × 9 + 8 ÷ 2

After interchanging + and -, 6 and 9 respectively

⇒ 9 + 5 × 6 - **8 ÷ 2**

⇒ 9 + **5 × 6**** **- 4

⇒ **9**____** + 30**__ - 4

⇒ __**39 - 4**__ = **35.**

II. 6 - 4 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3

After interchanging + and -, 6 and 9 respectively

⇒ 9 + 4 -** 6 × 5 ÷ 3**

⇒ **__9 +____ 4__ - 10**

**⇒ __13 - 10__ = 3**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
